title: Yellow Moon Beam Melon - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Early Ripening
description:
Sweet, early-ripening yellow-fleshed watermelon perfect for northern climates!


KEY FEATURES
• Early and prolific producer, ideal for cooler climates
• Sweet, crisp, bright yellow flesh with a thin rind
• Disease-resistant and tolerant to cooler weather
• Compact vine size, suitable for various garden spaces
• Fruits typically weigh 3-8 pounds, perfect for home gardens


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Fruits & Fruit Trees — Citrullus lanatus
Colour: Yellow flesh, light-green skin with dark-green stripes
Season: Summer (fruiting)
Growth Habit: Vine
Flavour: Cool, refreshing, and very sweet
Time to Harvest: 75-90 days from planting


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun (minimum 6 hours daily)
Soil: Well-drained, fertile soil, slightly acidic to neutral pH
Watering: Regular, consistent watering at the base of the plant; avoid overhead watering
Spacing: 2-3 feet apart, allowing vines to sprawl (approx. 60-72 inches diameter)
Height: 18-24 inches
Spread: 60-72 inches
Hardiness: 4-11 (grown as an annual in the UK)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant after all danger of frost has passed and soil temperature is at least 21°C (70°F).
• Provide consistent moisture, especially during fruit development; drip irrigation or soaker hoses are ideal.
• Fertilise every 6 weeks throughout the growing season, using a balanced fertiliser (low nitrogen, higher phosphorus and potassium).
• Ensure plants receive at least 6-8 hours of direct sunlight daily for optimal sweetness and growth.
• Protect from cool winds and ensure warm growing conditions for best results.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
